summary: Item 'session' built (not committed). FOUND (item 1, reproduced on a copy through the start-script probe, three starts each, logs/repro.r.*): the tabs were not 'unknown' by accident of a fault: WorkspaceTabs.open_record simply had no entry for any room the desk opens by its place (Documents, Files, Library, Agenda, DELETE, Changes, Night Shift, Investigations, Deployment), nor the ten app rooms, nor the 21 tabs the bridge opens from its navigation (Commands, Discovery, Brain, Memory...), nor Background service, This Computer or Pills. open_record returned None, the row went to Reopen deferred tabs, and nothing was printed. Run A (Documents, Files, Agenda open once): set aside at start 2 and 3. Run B (owner reopens Documents and Files each evening): saved deferred [] -> [Documents, Files] -> [Documents, Files, Documents, Files], one more row per room per start. The sweep found one more fault: leaving with Night Shift open raised AttributeError in WorkspaceTabs.descriptor (its 'path' attribute is a QComboBox, a chooser, not a file), so that session was not saved at all. FIXED in workbench/workspace_tabs.py: those kinds are reopened through shell2.open_destination (Files in the folder it was in, the Library on the kind it showed, an app room by its key), waiting until the window is whole as the bridge's rooms already did, so every row keeps its turn and place; Background service, This Computer and Pills by their own openers; the navigation's tabs come back as the pin or the Preview they were, not as rooms. Reopen deferred tabs now holds a tab once (its newest row; a row of a tab that is open again is dropped), at most 20, and never 'Needs a project' or Files' start page (explanations, not places; FilesStart was never reopenable from the list anyway). The descriptor writes a path only when it is a path. ITEM 2: what one start set aside is said once, at the end of the restore, in the Activity (activity.record 'ledger.restore', read by the Activity tail, the right pane's Activity face and the Log through tail_words.readable), in words, the same in every look, e.g. 'Not reopened at start · Manual (it failed to open); Retired room (Graphite cannot reopen this kind of tab). Kept in Arrange → Reopen deferred tabs'. Reasons: five pins were already open / another tab was already in the Preview / it failed to open / it is no longer there / Graphite cannot reopen this kind of tab; up to four named, then 'N more'. The traceback still goes to stderr. The status bar named a menu that does not exist ('View →'): the item is under Arrange, now said so; the Reopen list shows names, not class names. ITEM 3, sweep of 102 openers (open on a new profile, leave, start again; scratch sweep.py): kind | saved | before -> after. Restored before and after: OfficeBuildingTab, SlateRoomTab (also 'matrix'), ProjectDeskTab, SettingsTab, BrainLinkTab, EngineeringTab, ManualTab, ToolInventoryTab, BoardViewerTab, DevelopmentTab, GenesisTab, RegisterTab, ReadinessTab, ProjectSearchTab, VendorTab, ClipWorkspaceTab, ConcernDossier, CodeEditor (txt, md, csv, py) | saved | restored -> restored. DocumentsTab, FilesTab (files, files:Slate, work copy), TrashTab, AgendaTab, ChangesTab, DeploymentTab, InvestigationTab, LibraryTab (7 filters) | saved | set aside -> restored. App rooms MailRoom, BlenderRoom, GodotRoom, TransferRoom, CartridgeRoom, InkscapeRoom, MediaRoom, FreeCADRoom, PrintProofRoom, DeliveryRoom | saved | set aside -> restored. Navigation tabs DiscoveryTab, AlgorithmAtlasTab, ToolAtlasTab, CommandsTab, WorkTrailTab, OrganizerTab, PackageTab, View (Object Glass), BrainTab, IntakeTab, ReferenceTab, KnowledgeTab, MemoryTab, AwarenessTab, DeveloperToolsTab, KiBotTab, SpiceTab, YosysTab, ImplementationTab, HdlTab, StacyFoundationTab | saved | set aside -> restored. HostPanel, ComputerTab, PillsTab | saved | set aside -> restored. WorkTab (Night Shift) | NOT saved (raised at leaving) | lost -> saved and restored. QTextBrowser (setup guide), CompareTab, ExploreTab | saved | set aside -> set aside, listed once (they need what they were opened on, which is not saved; QTextBrowser is too generic a class to map). EmptyWorkspaceTab ('Needs a project', 16 openers in a workspace with no project) and FilesStart (2) | saved | set aside -> not reopened, by design. No tab (Activity, Reading dialog, Recovery, Remote link): nothing to restore. Raises at restore: none before or after. Two openers raise when OPENED (not a restore fault, not fixed): Asset gallery (FileNotFoundError: branding/ux17/visual-foundation.zip, which is absent from the delivered tree too) and Parser review (FileNotFoundError: project/review/command_parser/SOURCE.json in an Office workspace). Tests: test_session_start 23/23 in both looks; importers test_delete_words, test_one_name, test_graphite, test_release_check all green in both looks.

decisions: Rooms the desk opens by a place are reopened through shell2.open_destination rather than a new opener per kind: one path for the menu, the Library rows, the type bar and the restore. They wait until the window is whole, as the bridge's rooms already did, because the Library is opened by the shell and the app rooms and the navigation's tabs by the bridge, both installed after the session is restored.

The navigation's tabs (Commands, Brain...) are restored as what they were, a pin or the Preview, not as rooms, so they never replace a restored Preview; a second unpinned one is set aside with that reason, as any second Preview always was.

'View' (the Object Glass class) is mapped because the class name is unique in workbench; QTextBrowser (the setup guide) is not, because the class is generic. Compare and Explore are not restored: what they were opened on is not saved, and saving it was more than this item's 'keep the changes small'. They are listed once, with the words 'Graphite cannot reopen this kind of tab'.

'Needs a project' (EmptyWorkspaceTab) and Files' start page (FilesStart) are not reopened and are dropped from the list, as the legacy Start tab already was: they explain or point, they hold nothing; FilesStart could never be reopened from the list anyway (open_record returned None for it on purpose).

One tab is one row: the key ignores whether it was pinned, the cursor, the PDF page, the title, Files' folder and the Library's filter (each of those is one room); the newest row wins; the list keeps 20. The plan named no bound; 20 is four times the five pins and fits the chooser.

The note goes to the Activity journal (activity.record), the place the desk already says it opened ('ledger.open'); the Activity tail, the right pane's Activity face and the Log all read it through tail_words.readable, so it is the same in every look. Only rows set aside at this start are said, once, at the end of the restore; rows already in the list from earlier starts are not said again.

The status bar's words were wrong ('View → Reopen deferred tabs': the item is in the menu titled Arrange); fixed while there, and the test checks the named menu really holds the item. The Reopen list's labels were class names ('DocumentsTab'); they are the tab's title, file or kind in words now. The descriptor saves the tab's title for that.
The class-name literal 'StacyFoundationTab' in workspace_tabs is listed in tools/name_sweep.CODE_KEPT with its reason, as the sweep asks, instead of being disguised.
qt_app.py was not touched (restore_waiting_tabs already opens what waits), so the change stays inside the strip's own module.

Both raise at the owner's click, not at start.

The rooms reopen on their own first view: the document open in Documents, the investigation open in Investigations and the assignment chosen in Night Shift are not saved. Compare, Explore and the setup guide are still set aside (listed once).

The whole suite was not run (the coordinator runs it in both looks at merge); only test_session_start and the modules importing the touched files (test_delete_words, test_one_name, test_graphite, test_release_check), each in both looks. Modules that reach workspace_tabs only through qt_app were not run.
The Activity line was checked in the offscreen window's Activity tail (both looks via the suite's look switch), not by eye in the full-screen session; nothing ran on the owner's ThinkPad.
No new test module, so no FOCUSED_MODULES line in tools/check_hatch.py. Not committed; wip/, the version, release notes, MANIFEST.json and the seed are untouched.
release_note: Graphite now reopens every tab you left open at your last session: Documents, Files in the folder you were in, the Library, the Agenda, DELETE, Changes, Night Shift, Investigations, the app rooms and the tool tabs, where they were. Until now they went under Arrange → Reopen deferred tabs at every start, and that list grew by one entry per room each time; it now holds each tab once and never more than twenty. When a start cannot reopen something, it says so once in Activity, in plain words, with the reason and where to find it. Leaving with Night Shift open no longer loses the session.
